title: Toeplitz Matrix
goal: Decide whether every northwest-to-southeast diagonal is constant.
strategy: A cell belongs to the same diagonal as its northwest neighbor. Local equality therefore proves whole-diagonal equality.

phasePurposes.inspect: A cell belongs to the same diagonal as its northwest neighbor. Local equality therefore proves whole-diagonal equality.
phasePurposes.update: Each cell agrees with its northwest neighbor, so every diagonal is constant.
phasePurposes.done: Each cell agrees with its northwest neighbor, so every diagonal is constant.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
